name: baseball-dice
description: Baseball Dice - juego de béisbol con dados (PWA / Android APK / iOS IPA)
author: jennypower128@gmail.com

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
